protected.reason: The runtime orchestrator is intentionally the application-wide composition root. Domain multiplicity here is convergence, not mixed implementation ownership.
Registries intentionally aggregate feature declarations and should only be split through an explicit architectural decision.
Registry cores are public composition infrastructure rather than ordinary implementation files.

role_rules.reason: Ordinary domain orchestrators may be decomposed when implementation responsibilities have accreted; application composition roots should be explicitly protected above.
Feature-package files are intended to remain thin aggregation spines. If they become large, move implementation out while retaining the package boundary.
